pages.raw_meta: Our digital marketplaces offer a fast, easy and transparent way to sell and source used vehicle inventory—anytime, anywhere.
raw_blocks: Building the world’s greatest digital marketplace for used vehicles
Our digital marketplaces offer a fast, easy and transparent way to sell and source used vehicle inventory—anytime, anywhere.
We bring together the leading OEMs, dealers, fleet operators, rental companies and financial institutions to match the right buyer with the right car for every lot.
And beyond the technology, our people are dedicated to helping every customer—big or small—achieve the best outcomes possible.
building the world’s most advanced—and uncomplicated—digital marketplace for used vehicles.
helping customers buy and sell smarter with clear, actionable insights they can understand and use.
And we’re an innovation company
accelerating the future of wholesale remarketing through curiosity, collaboration and an entrepreneurial spirit.
gross merchandise value in 2025

Headquartered in Carmel, Indiana, OPENLANE’s global footprint spans more than 90 operating locations across North America, Europe, the Philippines and Uruguay. Our automotive marketplaces, technology platforms and other services support customers in about 40 countries around the globe.
